description: This file defines the AWS SDK client class for the Partner Central Selling API, including doc-comments that describe the various service methods available for interacting with the API.

classes.name: PartnerCentralSellingClient
classes.description: A client class derived from AwsClient, providing methods to interact with the Partner Central Selling API.

methods.name: acceptEngagementInvitation
methods.description: Sends a request to accept an engagement invitation via the API.

methods.name: acceptEngagementInvitationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously sends a request to accept an engagement invitation.

methods.name: assignOpportunity
methods.description: Assigns an opportunity using the API.

methods.name: createResourceSnapshotJob
methods.description: Creates a job to generate a resource snapshot.

methods.name: createResourceSnapshotJobAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a resource snapshot job.

methods.name: deleteResourceSnapshotJobAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a resource snapshot job.

methods.name: getResourceSnapshotJobAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a resource snapshot job.

methods.name: listEngagementByAcceptingInvitationTasks
methods.description: Lists tasks for engagement invitations accepted.

methods.name: listEngagementByAcceptingInvitationTasksAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tasks for engagement invitations accepted.

methods.name: listEngagementFromOpportunityTasks
methods.description: Lists engagement tasks related to opportunities.

methods.name: listEngagementFromOpportunityTasksAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists engagement tasks related to opportunities.

methods.name: listEngagementMembers
methods.description: Lists members involved in an engagement.

methods.name: listEngagementResourceAssociations
methods.description: Lists resource associations for an engagement.

methods.name: listEngagementResourceAssociationsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists resource associations for an engagement.

methods.name: putSellingSystemSettings
methods.description: Updates or sets selling system settings.

methods.name: putSellingSystemSettingsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously updates or sets selling system settings.

methods.name: startEngagementByAcceptingInvitationTask
methods.description: Starts an engagement by accepting an invitation task.

methods.name: startEngagementByAcceptingInvitationTaskAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously starts an engagement by accepting an invitation task.

methods.name: startEngagementFromOpportunityTask
methods.description: Starts engagement from an opportunity task.

methods.name: startEngagementFromOpportunityTaskAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously starts engagement from an opportunity task.

methods.name: startResourceSnapshotJobAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously starts a resource snapshot job.

methods.name: stopResourceSnapshotJobAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously stops a resource snapshot job.
